func work(items: [Item]) async throws {
let WIDTH = 4
let ONE = 1
for i in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: 1) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    group.addTask { try await read(items[i]) }
  }
}
for i in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: 2) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    group.addTask { try await read(items[i]) }
  }
}
for i in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: WIDTH) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    group.addTask { try await read(items[i]) }
  }
}
for i in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: ONE) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    group.addTask { try await read(items[i]) }
  }
}
for i in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: unknownWidth) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    group.addTask { try await read(items[i]) }
  }
}
}
